authority: City of Toronto — Toronto Island Ferry Service (Parks, Forestry & Recreation)
operator_note: Toronto Island ferries operated by the City of Toronto from the Jack Layton Ferry Terminal. Stakeholder = City of Toronto. Public municipal water-transit service.
seed_node_coords_source: Toronto Inner Harbour water between Jack Layton Ferry Terminal (9 Queens Quay W) and Centre Island; mint on water. Retrieved 2026-07-02.
decarbonization_anchor: City of Toronto is procuring an all-electric island ferry fleet to replace vessels aged 50-100 years; ~18,000 daily riders. A zero-emission foiling tier accelerates that electrification mandate and adds fast direct runs across the Inner Harbour.
network_reality: Year-round service from Jack Layton Ferry Terminal to three island destinations (mid-Apr to mid-Oct full service): Centre Island, Hanlan's Point, Ward's Island. ~18,000 daily riders in peak season.

piers.name: Jack Layton Ferry Terminal (9 Queens Quay W, mainland hub)

geometry_note: Short protected crossings across Toronto Inner Harbour; hand-waypoint around the island shoreline and the harbour breakwater; no land crossings. Single mainland hub, hub-and-spoke to 3 island docks.
